scope: First working system suspend (s2idle) on the Fx0: in-cell touchscreen and MDP5 fixes
kernel_support: s2idle only (/sys/power/mem_sleep [s2idle]); no cpuidle states; wake sources include the PM8226 RTC and power key

touch_blocks_suspend.symptom: rmi_i2c suspend fails with -110 and aborts s2idle
touch_blocks_suspend.trace: msm's PM prepare switches the display off (68.105-68.320 s); at 68.293 s the PLG430 raises an interrupt and every I2C transfer to it stalls 15.4 s and times out (IRQ-thread read, then the F01 sleep-mode write [0e 81]); the stock LG driver sent panel TP-disable commands around touch power changes - the controller is part of the in-cell panel
touch_blocks_suspend.aftermath: rmi_i2c_suspend() asserts reset and disables the supplies, then returns the error; the PM core never resumes that device, so touch stays dead (GPIO16 driven low) until the driver is rebound

mdp5_stale_hwpipe.symptom: after one successful suspend/resume (or a failed suspend's prepare/complete), the next DPMS off or suspend prepare warns at mdp5_pipe.c:138 and msm_kms_pm_prepare returns -22
mdp5_stale_hwpipe.cause: drm_atomic_helper_suspend() saves plane states but not the mdp5 global (private object) state; the suspend commit releases every hwpipe in the global state; the resume commit restores plane states that still name their old hwpipes, which the atomic check keeps without re-recording them

results.r18: first successful s2idle (RTC wake 15 s); owner: Sxmo and touch work after resume; the second suspend then failed in msm_kms_pm_prepare (mdp5 warning)

r19_cycles.criteria: rtcwake rc 0, suspend_stats success +1, taint 0, touch IC answers, both remoteprocs running, sound card, msmdrmfb, sway running

results.r19_dpms: sway output power off/on: no mdp5 warning, taint 0; the panel follower powers the touch IC down with the panel (reset asserted, L28 off) and up again (IC answers)
results.power_key_wake: r19: s2idle with a 180 s RTC backstop; owner pressed Power after about 10 s; resumed after 13 s (rtcwake rc 0, suspend_stats success +1, taint 0); owner confirms Sxmo and touch after wake

sway_power_on.repro: swaymsg output DSI-1 power off; sleep 3; swaymsg output DSI-1 power on -> sway logs 'Backend commit failed' and the output stays off; an immediate second 'power on' succeeds (3 of 3)
sway_power_on.analysis: with sway -d and drm.debug=0x16: wlroots' swapchain test commit and a second test pass in the kernel (no warnings, mdp5 assigns DMA0 and SMP blocks), sway renders the first frame, then the real commit fails before any ioctl and wlroots logs nothing; the session stays active; every logged failure path in the wlroots 0.20.2 DRM backend was ruled out by reading the source
sway_power_on.impact: Sxmo screen-on after blanking would need a second attempt
sway_power_on.status: open; userspace (wlroots/sway) bug; a report upstream needs the owner's approval
